# Practice Exam Generator {.unnumbered}

**Time allowed** 2 hours · **Total** 100 marks

Answer all seven questions and show your working. Use the [Formula Sheet](formula-sheet.qmd)
and any reference values supplied in the questions.

```{=html}
<div class="exam-controls">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="generate-practice-exam" disabled>Generate new exam</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="print-practice-exam" disabled>Print / Save as PDF</button>
</div>
<p id="practice-exam-status" role="status"></p>
<noscript><p>Enable JavaScript to generate a practice exam.</p></noscript>

<div id="practice-exam" hidden>
  <section aria-labelledby="practice-exam-a">
    <h2 id="practice-exam-a">Section A <span>40 marks</span></h2>
    <div id="practice-exam-a-questions"></div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="practice-exam-b">
    <h2 id="practice-exam-b">Section B <span>60 marks</span></h2>
    <div id="practice-exam-b-questions"></div>
  </section>
  <div class="exam-review">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="toggle-practice-exam-solutions" aria-controls="practice-exam-solutions" aria-expanded="false">Show solutions</button>
    <div id="practice-exam-solutions" hidden></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
